drivingQuestion: May a minor with exposed limbs read from the Torah?

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ: וְתִיבְּעֵי לָךְ עָרוֹם! עָרוֹם מַאי טַעְמָא לָא — מִשּׁוּם כְּבוֹד צִבּוּר, הָכָא נָמֵי מִשּׁוּם כְּבוֹד צִבּוּר.
segments.en: Abaye «said to him: And» according to this reasoning, «raise the dilemma» with regard to a minor who is totally «naked. What is the reason that» a minor who is «naked may not» read the Torah? It is «due to respect for the public. Here, too,» a poḥe’aḥ may not read from the Torah «due to respect for the public.»

moves.summary: compares to a naked minor: forbidden due to respect for the public
moves.about: a minor poheah may not read, like a naked minor, out of respect for the congregation

edges.about: a minor poheah may not read, like a naked minor, out of respect for the congregation

positions.claim: a minor poheah may not read Torah
positions.basis: כבוד צבור, as with a naked minor
